# P1.08 — Versions/diffs, full: rail chips, compare, restore, Files pane

Spec: `docs/tickets/36_P1.08__versions-and-diffs-full.md` · run ledger: `docs/build/runs/P1.08.md`
**Stage A only** — all code + deterministic tests. Stage B (deploy `api` + `web` + `collab` to `dev`,
bounded live verify, $0) is operator-gated → **D-P1.08-1**.

## Summary

The version story closes (§5.8 + §5.13): a **rail of version chips** over the Page (every origin,
🔒 frozen / working-dot state, reviewed + answered flags, claims-pending-verification chip,
project ⚑ obligation count), the **three-layout compare** at `/p/:project/v/:n/diff/:m` — side,
inline, and What-changed-and-why (moves) — with inline hunk comments that land
`Guidance{source:'inline_comment', workflows:['revise']}` for the next Revise, the **restore-point
dropdown** (§5.8 groups: named / earlier today / yesterday / before review / older-behind-Advanced)
driving preview-against-head and an **undoable** apply (a pre-restore "Before restore" point is
written; the apply lands as a new version, never a mutation), and the **Files pane** — the §5.13
typed artifact browser with provenance badges, lock icons, and freshness notes — every artifact
reachable without ever showing a filesystem.

## What landed

**`@rhema/contracts`** — `artifact-policy.ts` gains the §5.13 `BROWSER_SECTIONS` +
`browserSectionFor(kind)` map: the ONE authority grouping the 63 kinds into
outline/drafts/rounds/research/voice/assets/advanced. `H` kinds carry a nominal section for the
sealed count only — never a row, never a link; unknown kinds are unlisted.

**`@rhema/editor` + `@rhema/mirror`** — the Yjs bridge moved `apps/collab` → `packages/editor`
(`ydoc.ts`), and the restore store/reconstruction primitives moved → `packages/mirror`
(`restore.ts`: `RestoreBlobStore`, `createGcsRestoreBlobStore`, the `restore/` key layout,
daily-snapshot + delta reconstruction). Collab imports the shared implementation — the api can now
preview/restore the same chains the collab service writes.

**`apps/api`** — `what-changed.ts` gains `loadVersionDiff`: the generalized compare over arbitrary
draft pairs (`m` may be `working`), direction normalized to lower-numbered = before, diffing
promoted markdown heads (base-draft fallback for working heads); when the pair is a review/revise
transition it finds the linking `response` and reuses the full ledger/findings/obligation-discharge/
summary-strip assembly — otherwise it emits the unlinked coherence read (all hunks Unlinked).
`version-routes.ts` (new): `GET /projects/:id/versions` (the rail read model — every origin chip,
frozen/working state, reviewed + answered flags, `claims_pending_verification` on human revisions,
per-draft + project ⚑ open-obligation counts), `GET /projects/:id/v/:n/diff/:m` +
`POST …/hunks/:hunkId/comments` (server-resolved hunk → Guidance), `GET /projects/:id/files`
(default SE/SR `rows` + I-level `advancedRows` + H sealed counts, provenance/lock/freshness/
word-count/draft-refs per row), and the restore triple `GET …/drafts/:did/restore-points`,
`GET …/restore-points/:rp/preview` (reconstruct point → diff vs head), `POST …/restore`
(pre-restore undo point → `saveManualRevision`; frozen target forks `v(N+1) human_revision`,
working `human_revision` head updates in place, agent/imported working heads 409; run-lock held →
409). `editor-routes.ts`: the artifact Page read refuses H-level kinds (404 — absent, not locked;
REQ-VIS-3). `index.ts`/`server.ts` mount the routes + the `restoreBlobs` dep (GCS live, in-memory
in tests).

**`@rhema/ui`** — three new framework-independent components: `version-rail.tsx` (chips with
`data-version-chip`/`data-lock`/`data-working-dot`/`data-reviewed`/`data-answered`/
`data-claims-pending`/`data-obligations-chip`, per-version `/v/:n` links, the stamped
`data-compare-previous` link, the §5.8-grouped restore dropdown with preview + restore slots),
`compare.tsx` (the three layouts read-only; hunk comment forms on **all** layouts; discharge lines
+ summary strip on moves; rebutted findings with rationale; the unlinked banner),
`files-pane.tsx` (typed sections, provenance badge, lock icon, freshness `describes vN — since
edited`, `N sealed` for H, read-only note for agent memory). `ide-shell.tsx` mounts the rail over
the Page and the Files pane as a pane.

**`apps/web`** — route `/p/:project/v/:n/diff/:m` (`?layout=side|inline|moves`), the Page route
loads the rail + restore points (all optional seams — fixtures without them render unchanged),
`?focus=1` honored, H-artifact `/a/:id` 404s, compare hunk-comment POSTs redirect `?commented=`,
the restore apply POST returns `restored_as_version`/`undo_point_id` (undo = the pre-restore
point at `/v/:v/restore/:rp`). `client/ide.ts`: `[`/`]` step versions; `⌘⇧C` follows the rail's
compare-previous link (palette `/compare` fallback). `commands/resolve.ts`: `/compare @v2 @v3`
resolves to the real `/v/2/diff/3` route.
